symptom: `MDL-WIDGET16` fires 44 times on one project, once per DataGrid 2 column, all saying the same thing
cause: The rule was written per column when the fact — this grid stores no column names — belongs to the grid. Correct but chatty enough to bury the rest of the report
file: `mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go` (`validateDataGrid2ColumnNames`, now called per widget rather than per object-list item)
insight: Emit one violation per grid listing each `written → addressable` mapping. **Generalisable**: an advisory rule's unit should be the thing the advice is about, not the thing that triggered it — N identical infos train the reader to skip the category. Feedback on a rule shipped days earlier, from the project using it. mxcli-dbreplication F6
